When the top bolt was removed, a portion of the pipe was pulled upward, and the other portion fell to floor. The employee's finger was pinched between lower handle of pliers and the portion of pipe supported by the crane. The employee suffered an amputation to his left ring finger.

An employee was emptying a filter pod at the flare stack when a small flame came out of the top of the flare stack, landed in the condensate, and burned him. He suffered second degree burns to the hands, stomach, and calves, requiring hospitalization.

On March 15, at 11 a.m., an employee was running a cable to the floor of a pulling unit when the employee was shocked by approximately 1,050 volts DC from the trailer truck. The employee was hospitalized with an electrical shock to the hands.
An employee was removing a pipe from his truck when his middle finger got caught in the D ring on the pipe, resulting in a fingertip amputation up to the first knuckle.
An employee was shocked when the trackhoe he was loading onto a trailer made contact with power lines.

An employee was getting ready to climb a ladder to a chemical float trailer. He had put his right hand on the lower section of the ladder when it shifted, causing his right ring finger to be caught between the ladder and the trailer. His fingertip was amputated.
An employee was installing a vent chimney for a gas fireplace and fell from the roof to the ground below. The employee was hospitalized with bilateral foot fractures.

An employee was using a pry bar to guide the base of a jib crane over the bolts in the floor. The base was suspended by straps attached to a forklift. The base slipped in the straps and pinned the employee's right hand between the pry bar and the floor, breaking his right index finger and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was running a string of pipe from a derrick basket when his shirt was caught by the rotating torque rod. It pulled his shirt tight, compressing his chest against the derrick basket. He suffered chest bruising and lost consciousness, requiring hospitalization.
A service technician was repairing a natural gas regulator that was leaking. When the water heater valve was opened, natural gas ignited, and the technician sustained burns to the arms.
An employee's foot got crushed between the floor and boom of a drill rig. He broke his big toe.

An employee was removing a threaded grease fitting from a valve. As the fitting came loose, it struck the employee's hand. Air, water, and grease also released with some pressure. The pressure or the fitting lacerated the employee's hand between the thumb and forefinger and abraded the skin between the thumb and wrist. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.
While moving drums in the back of a delivery truck, an employee fell from the truck to the ground, suffering a concussion and head laceration. The employee was hospitalized.
While flushing chemical from a tanker truck an explosion occurred that burned three employees. One of the injured employees was hospitalized with burns to the face and hands.

On 7/13/2018, an employee climbed an 8-foot A-frame ladder to tape an area for painting. The employee finished and was starting to descend when the employee missed one of the ladder rungs and fell to the ground. The employee suffered a head cut and broken right ankle, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee finished installing power line poles and stepped into a truck. The truck derrick made contact with the power line (12kV), resulting in electric shock to the employee. The employee received burns to the hands, feet, and internal body parts.

Employees were constructing a tank battery and removing a bottom hatch with a grinder when a fire and explosion occurred from an empty tank. The injured employee received body burns that required hospitalization.
An employee was helping load a trailer. The vehicle was jostled and his left middle finger was crushed between the truck and the hitch. He suffered an amputation to the finger.
An employee was cleaning a H2S (hydrogen sulfide) tower using a H2O2 (hydrogen peroxide) chemical when a chemical explosion occurred. The employee suffered burns to an ear and leg.

An employee was retrieving material from the open bin of a digger derrick when the digger derrick contacted 7,200-volt primary electric lines. The employee sustained an electrical shock that went through his arms and exited his right foot.

An employee was tasked with welding a pipe. As he was getting a cutting torch from a toolbox on a buggy, he became caught between the side boom of a pipelayer and the buggy. He suffered internal bleeding and damage to his small intestine, requiring hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was using compressed air to blow a sponge through a concrete pipeline to clean the pipe. The employee was disengaging the fitting of the air hose reducer, which was still under pressure, when the reducer struck the employee just below the hard hat line. The employee suffered a concussion, brain bleed, and forehead laceration.
An employee was fixing a damaged pipeline and was struck by a pickup truck. The employee suffered a broken leg, rib trauma, damaged spleen and a punctured lung.
